name: grounding_failure
title: A draft with one free-typed number is refused
protects: The grounding gate end to end through the CLI. The good draft with one token replaced by its typed-out value (238.99%) must fail render with exit 4 and exactly G2 BARE_NUMBER; only grounding_report.json is written and a stale commentary.md is deleted. Not a PLAN case id (PLAN covers this as mutant M11 on G01).
